blurb: Carol's Massage provides personalized massage services including Swedish massage, hot stone therapy, lymphatic massage, reflexology, therapeutic and deep tissue massage, European facial, and cupping. They focus on stress management, relaxation, injury and chronic pain management using Eastern and Western techniques.
